_meta.source: LP fixture tools/fixtures/lp_probes/tuplet.svg — the COMPOSER'S OWN standard, surveyed from piece #2's lilypond_code (809 .ly files, 101 with tuplets): TupletBracket.direction #UP (29/29), bracket-visibility ##t (190 uses), padding 0.5 ('bracket height', 36), TupletNumber.text = tuplet-number::calc-fraction-text (29/32), font-size -5 (32), plus the composer's own flatten-tuplet-bracket scheme function (41 uses) which levels both bracket ends to the higher one.
_meta.pipelineCheck: a c'' notehead in the same fixture matched the ported notehead.filled byte-for-byte
_meta.note: NO GLYPH TRACING NEEDED. The bracket is procedural in LP too - four <line> strokes, not a glyph. The NUMERAL came out as an SVG <text> element (serif italic), not an Emmentaler outline: LP's SVG backend typesets tuplet numbers as text. So the bracket is drawn and the numeral is set in the app's own notation font (Crimson Pro), at the measured proportions.

bracket.hookDirection: toward the notes (down, when direction is UP)
